If you've received a codec call mentioning a third party sniper in the AO, and go to the ruins in the northern part of Afghanistan (you must pass through it to get the power plant), you'll trigger the fight with Quiet. I had no idea what was coming and had only the tranq pistol and the AK clone with me at the time. The fight is doable with the Wu, once you learn her movements and where she'll typically set up it becomes relatively simple to pop out and fire a couple rounds then hide before she can fire. It is tedious and you have to get close to get reliable hits, which means lots of crawling, but it's not too bad, really. It took me two tries, both around 20-30 minutes, so I don't think any of you should have much trouble.

That said, I'd recommend staying to the southern part of the map until you can get a long range rifle, tranq or otherwise. You do get a bonus for using only a tranq, something like 15,000 or so points.
